descriptions.jk_cement_dealer_engagement_step1: Festive Campaign ZoTok pushes a targeted bulk purchase campaign to all active dealers in the territory to drive seasonal orders and awareness.
descriptions.jk_cement_dealer_engagement_step2: Scheme Notification ZoTok pushes the latest bulk dairy scheme as a marketing message to dealers, driving awareness and incremental orders.
descriptions.jk_cement_dealer_engagement_step3: Points Wallet Inquiry Ramesh asks about his points balance — ZoAi instantly explains the quarterly gift redemption tiers in Hinglish.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step1: Menu Navigation Dealer selects 'Order Now' from the self-service menu to begin placing an order — entirely within WhatsApp.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step2: WebView Catalog Dealer browses the full JK Cement product catalog inside WhatsApp's native browser with real product images and pricing.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step3: Handwritten Order Dealer photographs a handwritten order note and sends it directly to the ZoTok channel on WhatsApp.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step4: Back Office Order Dashboard JK Cement's fulfilment team sees all incoming dealer orders on the ZoTok portal. They select JKO-48291 from Sharma Cement Stores (₹35,080 · 4 SKUs) to review and process.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step5: Order Confirmed Notification JK Cement's ERP triggers a WhatsApp confirmation once the order is approved. The previous "Order Received" message is shown faded for context. The single CTA links to read-only order details.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step6: ZoTok × SAP Integration Once the dealer's order is confirmed on WhatsApp and approved in the ZoTok PWA, it is pushed to SAP via ZoTok's integration layer. The JSON payload flows through the API Gateway → Payload Transformation → SAP Adapter, triggering the full order-to-bill cycle in SAP SD/FI — from sales order creation and credit check through delivery, picking, and billing document generation. OData callbacks flow back to ZoTok to update the dealer via WhatsApp.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step7: New Invoice Notification When the order is billed in SAP, ZoTok instantly sends the invoice PDF to the dealer on WhatsApp. The message highlights the 2.5% cash discount window (7 days) and the full due date — prompting early payment.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step8: Cash Discount Reminder (Auto) ZoTok automatically sends this reminder 1 day before the 7-day cash discount deadline. Dealers who haven't paid yet see exactly how much they stand to save — creating urgency without being pushy.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step9: Payment Received Notification ZoTok receives the bank transfer from JK Cement's ERP and notifies the dealer via WhatsApp with the payment receipt PDF. Since no invoice clearing document exists yet, ZoTok prompts the dealer to submit division-wise settlement details.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step10: Credit Note Issued When SAP FI raises a credit note (scheme incentive or return refund), the event triggers ZoTok via webhook. ZoTok instantly sends the PDF with credit details. The dealer can view the note or tap Download Ledger to get a full statement.
descriptions.jk_cement_order_to_cash_step11: Navigation Drawer Dealer taps the JK Cement logo (hamburger) in the header — the side navigation drawer slides in, giving access to Dashboard, Order History, Invoices, Payments, and Ledger from a single portal.
descriptions.jk_cement_retailer_onboarding_step1: Activation Campaign ZoTok sends a WhatsApp marketing message to prospective retailers, inviting them to register as official JK Cement retail partners.
descriptions.jk_cement_retailer_onboarding_step2: Partner Approved Once the application is reviewed and approved, the retailer automatically receives a welcome message on this channel.
descriptions.jk_cement_retailer_onboarding_step3: Festive Campaign ZoTok pushes a targeted Diwali campaign to all active retailers in the territory to drive seasonal orders and awareness.
descriptions.jk_cement_retailer_onboarding_step4: Scheme Notification ZoTok pushes the latest Monsoon Protection Scheme as a marketing message to retailers, driving awareness and incremental orders.

descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step1: Adding Team Members Priya Nair (coordinator) creates the dedicated customer group. She adds Rajesh Shah (customer), Amit Joshi (mapped sales person), Suresh Patil (manager), and ZoAi bot — the AI agent that will process all enquiries automatically.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step2: Customer Drops the Requirement Rajesh Shah (customer) sends a free-text enquiry — SS 304 coils, 2mm × 1250mm, 5 MT, delivery Bhiwandi by next Wednesday. This is unstructured text, just as it would happen in any WhatsApp group today.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step3: Structured Data Written to Sheet ZoAi's NLU engine parses Rajesh's free-text message and extracts: material (SS 304 Coil), dimensions (2mm × 1250mm), quantity (5 MT), delivery location (Bhiwandi), and required-by date (20-May-2026). A new row is automatically inserted into the Enquiries Google Sheet — no coordinator needed to manually type this.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step4: Zero Manual Steps — Fully Automated From the moment Priya tags @zoai, the entire quote preparation, routing, approval, and PDF generation happens automatically. The team focuses on the approval decision — everything else is handled by ZoTok + Google Sheets automation.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step5: Sheet Updated — ZoAi Triggers Delivery Suresh Patil approves the quote in the ZoTok admin portal. The sheet status updates to "Quote Approved", Quote No QT-2026-01129 is written, and the PDF URL is attached. ZoAi detects this status change via a sheet webhook and immediately prepares to send the quote PDF back into the customer group.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step6: Group Notification + Review Link ZoAi sends the PDF in the customer group (within 24hr session window — no template approval needed) along with a short review URL. It also informs Rajesh that a formal approval message has been sent directly to his WhatsApp from Blue Ocean's official business account.
descriptions.journey_customer_groups_step7: Order Confirmed — Full Cycle Complete Rajesh types the confirmation keyword in the group. ZoAi detects it, logs the order confirmation against QT-2026-01129, updates the sheet status to "Booking In Progress", and replies in the group. From free-text enquiry to confirmed order — entirely within WhatsApp, with minimal team effort.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step2: 7:30 AM morning routine — update rates, send broadcast Every morning at 7:30 AM the coordinator updates today's poultry rates and clicks Send Messages . Dealer, wholesaler, and retailer rows carry the segment price, stock remarks, and delivery status ZoTok uses to personalize WhatsApp broadcasts and start order capture from replies.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step3: ZoTok Workspace Add-on — installed once, lives in every sheet The ZoTok add-on is published in Google Workspace Marketplace. Once installed by the org admin, it appears under Extensions › Zotok for every sheet user with no per-user setup. For Sakku's daily poultry price communication, the coordinator uses Extensions → Zotok → Campaign → Send Messages after updating the 7:30 AM rate sheet; ZoTok selects dealer, wholesaler, and retailer templates, drives WhatsApp engagement, and starts order generation from replies and CTAs.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step4: One click → 2,480 daily price messages queued ZoTok queues the daily Sakku price broadcast through WhatsApp Business API using pre-approved templates with placeholders replaced from the sheet rows. Campaign codes are detected for EGG-2026-06-01-DEALER , EGG-2026-06-01-RETAILER , and EGG-2026-06-01-WHOLESALER , covering dealers, retailers, and wholesalers in one run.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step5: Dealer broadcast — daily price update + order CTA The EGG-2026-06-01-DEALER template lands on dealer WhatsApp at 7:31 AM with layer egg, jumbo egg, and broiler rates. Place Order opens the ZoAi order capture flow; Talk To Sales hands off to the mapped sales representative.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step6: Broadcast → order capture → dispatch process The dealer starts from the broadcast CTA and ZoAi captures product, tray quantity, location, and delivery date before creating the order and notifying the Sakku sales representative. Final flow: Broadcast → Order Intent → Quantity Capture → Delivery Capture → Order Creation → Dispatch Process .
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step1: Direct Channel — No Dedicated Group Yet Vikram Patel (VPatel Steel Centre) is a customer who sends enquiries directly to Amit Joshi's personal WhatsApp number. There is no dedicated customer group set up for him. Amit receives the requirement as a free-text DM and will now forward it into the internal BOS team group using the @zoai trigger.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step2: BOS — The Internal Hub "BOS · Blue Ocean Steels Team" is the internal WhatsApp group where the entire sales team (executives, coordinator, manager) and ZoAi operate together. No customers are in this group. ZoAi posts a daily morning summary and processes any @zoai triggers that team members send for direct enquiries.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step3: Same Sheet — New Source Column ENQ-2026-04825 lands in the same unified Enquiries Log used by Journey 1. A new Source column (K) distinguishes how the enquiry arrived — "Direct (DM)" vs "Cust. Group". Quote columns (H–J) show dashes; the quote engine kicks off automatically.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step4: Identical Engine — Source Doesn't Matter Once an enquiry is in the Google Sheet, the automation pipeline is exactly the same whether it came from a dedicated customer group or a direct DM. The only difference downstream is the delivery channel: this customer gets Email + WABA instead of a group notification.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step5: Quote Approved — ZoAi Triggers Multi-Channel Delivery Suresh approves QT-2026-01130 in the admin portal. Sheet rows 4–5 update to "Quote Approved" with amounts ₹3,60,000 + ₹1,80,000 (total ₹5,40,000). ZoAi detects the status change and simultaneously sends the quote to the BOS group, Vikram's email, and Vikram's WhatsApp via WABA.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step6: Quote Arrives in Vikram's Email The quote email lands in Vikram's inbox simultaneously with the WABA message. It carries the full PDF, a line-item breakdown, and inline Approve / Reject buttons — so Vikram can act from any device, even without WhatsApp open.
descriptions.journey_direct_enquiries_step7: One Tap — Order Confirmed Vikram taps "Approve Quote" on the WABA template. The button triggers a WhatsApp reply message ("Approve Quote") which ZoAi detects instantly. ZoAi responds in the same DM with an order confirmation — no call, no email reply, no manual processing needed.
descriptions.journey_sales_to_cash_step2: Invoice Auto-Delivered from TallyPrime — Zero Manual Touch The moment a Sales Invoice voucher is saved in TallyPrime, a webhook fires to ZoTok. The Meta-approved utility template fills with TallyPrime data (invoice no, amount, due date) and lands on Vikram's WhatsApp — no email chase, no PDF attachment forwarding.
descriptions.journey_sales_to_cash_step3: TallyPrime-Driven Cash Discount Offer The day after dispatch, ZoTok reads the payment terms configured in TallyPrime and triggers a proactive discount offer. Vikram sees a clear "save ₹5,400 if you pay early" — a one-tap incentive that improves BOS cashflow without any sales rep chasing. The discount is automatically reconciled in TallyPrime when he pays within the window.
descriptions.journey_sales_to_cash_step4: TallyPrime Receipt Entry → Instant Acknowledgement The moment a Receipt voucher is saved in TallyPrime against Vikram's ledger, a webhook fires to ZoTok. The utility template fills with TallyPrime data — UTR, amount, date, cash discount auto-applied — and lands on his WhatsApp in seconds. No manual receipt emails, no delay.
descriptions.journey_sales_to_cash_step5: TallyPrime Credit Note → Instant WhatsApp Notification A Credit Note voucher is saved in TallyPrime → ZoTok webhook fires → WABA utility template with red PDF icon lands on Vikram's WhatsApp in seconds. Red PDF icon distinguishes credit/return documents from pink invoices at a glance. Note: demo shows both CTA URL and Quick Reply buttons to illustrate the flow — production templates use one button type only.
descriptions.journey_sales_to_cash_step6: Navigation Drawer — Everything One Tap Away Vikram taps the VP avatar in the header — the side navigation drawer slides in, giving access to Orders, Invoices, Payments, Credit Notes, Ledger, and Rate Card from a single portal. No app download, no login screen, no email chain.

descriptions.journey_support_tickets_step3: Source-of-Truth — Human Authored, ZoAi Persisted TKT-2026-00342 lands in the same Sheets layer the rest of BOS runs on. The footer trail is deliberate: "Logged by ZoAi on instruction from Priya Nair" — the team made the call, ZoAi only wrote the row. The internal WMS reads from this sheet to assign and track work.
descriptions.journey_support_tickets_step4: Sheet is the Contract — WMS is the Work Surface BOS team can work from the Sheet or the WMS — both stay in sync. The customer never sees either; they only see ZoAi's updates in their group. ZoAi sits in the pipes, not in the decisions.
descriptions.journey_support_tickets_step5: Team Works in WMS — One Click Syncs to Customer Suresh updates the ticket status and adds a note in the internal WMS. Clicking "Save & Sync" triggers ZoAi to auto-post the update into the customer's WhatsApp group — no manual messaging needed.
descriptions.journey_support_tickets_step6: Sheet Updated — Ticket Closed · SLA Met in 28 Hours Priya marks the ticket Resolved — the same Google Sheet that logged the ticket now shows its closure. Row 4 turns green, resolution date is stamped, and the SLA is recorded. This feeds the team's monthly support report automatically.

descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step1: Outbound nudge to sellers without an active listing A generic Utility template sent to any seller whose listing has expired or has never been created. Body has three bullets that lay out the listing process. Two Quick Reply buttons: “List New Stock” starts the listing flow, “View Menu” opens the always-available menu.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step2: Publish confirmation with the menu CTA on the same template One Utility template covers both: image header is the seller’s own stock photo, body shows the new Listing ID and 6-hour validity, and the “View Menu” CTA at the bottom opens the Interactive List.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step3: Renewal nudge sent 1 hour before listing expiry A Utility template fires 1 hour before the 6-hour listing window closes. Three Quick Reply buttons cover the three possible outcomes: extend the listing, edit qty/rate, or deactivate. Required to keep listings fresh under the 6-hour auto-expiry rule.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step4: Buyer-side flow shown as a 4-box diagram The Recykal Marketplace UI for matching and awarding is built and owned by Recykal’s product team — not in scope for this demo. The four boxes show how a buyer requirement flows into matching, allocation, and the WhatsApp handoff that fires the eight Accept / Reject templates to selected sellers. Quantities and chips are illustrative.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step5: Award template with two outcomes only The sub-PO PDF is the Document header. Body carries the full agreed terms (qty, rate, buyer, payment). Two Quick Reply buttons: Accept or Reject. There is no counter-offer path; price was set when the seller listed the stock.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step6: Signed contract delivered to the seller The follow-up Utility template carries the signed sub-PO PDF. Body names the seller (Om Metal) and the buyer (Tata Steel) explicitly — Recykal is the facilitator and is not on the contract or the invoice chain. The “View Contract” button opens the PDF.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step7: 3-member execution group, auto-created on acceptance Members: seller, Recykal facilitator (Rahul), ZoAi. The buyer is intentionally not in this group — they continue interacting via the Recykal app. The amber note in the group settings makes the room’s purpose explicit so it is not used as a negotiation thread.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step8: Seller drops 3 raw messages; ZoAi stays silent Weighbridge slip photo, vehicle/driver text, and the LR PDF land in the group as plain messages. ZoAi reads and categorises each one but does not post anything yet — nothing is created until a Recykal team member tags it with @zoai .
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step9: GRN auto-mirrored from buyer app (no @zoai tag needed) The GRN event is mirroring an external system action, not creating a record from scratch — so ZoAi posts the GRN ID, net received weight and variance into the group automatically. Creating records like dispatch notes, debit notes etc. still requires an explicit @zoai mention from a team member.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step10: Direct invoice generated, Recykal not on the document Seller is Om Metal, buyer is Tata Steel. The amber callout makes the separation explicit. Line value reflects the QC-accepted weight (7.90 MT) and the debit note is netted off before tax. Recykal charges its platform fee on a separate document, not on the trade invoice.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_marketplace_step11: Recykal HO control tower — single live ops view One screen for live listings, active awards and every running transaction group with a milestone progress bar. KPIs at the top, expiring-listing alerts in the middle, sub-PO milestones below. The page is fed by WhatsApp events and Recykal app actions; HO does not need to read individual group chats.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step1: PO captured once — no re-entry Amit Zaa fills in buyer, material, quantity, rate and terms directly in the Recykal Marketplace. The system auto-selects 47 matched suppliers based on material tags and region — nothing is typed into ZoTok.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step2: Status change is the broadcast trigger Amit selects “Publish / Live” and clicks Publish PO. Recykal’s backend immediately calls ZoTok’s Campaign API — no extra steps in any other tool.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step3: The supplier gets the broadcast One of 248 scrap aggregators receives the personalised requirement on WhatsApp. The CTA opens a form where the supplier can declare what stock they currently hold.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step4: Broadcast replies become leads Every supplier who submits availability lands on Recykal's procurement dashboard with quantity, grade, location and material photos already attached.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step5: Five-way deal room, auto-assembled The group is created the moment the lead is assigned — no manual setup. All five participants are added automatically: Tata Steel PM, both Recykal team members, the supplier, and ZoAi. The name embeds the Lead ID for traceability.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step6: Supplier opens, buyer holds firm Om Metal quotes ₹34,800. Vikram Singh (Tata Steel PM) immediately states the ₹34,500 ceiling — no back-channel call needed, the buyer's position is visible to everyone in the room.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step7: Head office stays in the loop Because ZoAi sits in every negotiation group, the coordination team gets a live tracker of all deal rooms and their agreed terms — full oversight without micromanaging.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step8: PO lands on the supplier's WhatsApp Recykal's WABA sends a Utility template with the PO PDF attached. The supplier taps "View PO" to open the full order in WhatsApp's browser.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step9: OTP-verified approval The supplier enters the 4-digit OTP delivered to their WhatsApp and submits. The PO acknowledgement is now legally traceable to a verified number.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step10: Delivery day alert On the morning of the delivery date, Recykal's WABA sends an automated reminder to the supplier. The "Create Dispatch" CTA links directly to the dispatch form — one tap to log vehicle and weights.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step11: One-click compliance Recykal’s marketplace auto-creates a GST-compliant invoice the moment dispatch details are submitted — seller, buyer, HSN code, IGST pre-validated against the sub-PO. Amit reviews the checklist and approves in seconds.
descriptions.journey_ms_scrap_procurement_step12: Invoice lands on WhatsApp — automatically Seconds after Amit approves, Om Metal Aggregators receives a utility template with the PDF attached. The supplier can download, verify and file it without leaving WhatsApp.

descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step2: 7:30 AM morning routine — update rates, send broadcast Every morning at 7:30 AM the coordinator updates today's poultry rates and clicks Send Messages . Dealer, wholesaler, and retailer rows carry the segment price, stock remarks, and delivery status ZoTok uses to personalize WhatsApp broadcasts and start order capture from replies.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step3: ZoTok Workspace Add-on — installed once, lives in every sheet The ZoTok add-on is published in Google Workspace Marketplace. Once installed by the org admin, it appears under Extensions › Zotok for every sheet user with no per-user setup. For Sakku's daily poultry price communication, the coordinator uses Extensions → Zotok → Campaign → Send Messages after updating the 7:30 AM rate sheet; ZoTok selects dealer, wholesaler, and retailer templates, drives WhatsApp engagement, and starts order generation from replies and CTAs.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step4: One click → 2,480 daily price messages queued ZoTok queues the daily Sakku price broadcast through WhatsApp Business API using pre-approved templates with placeholders replaced from the sheet rows. Campaign codes are detected for EGG-2026-06-01-DEALER , EGG-2026-06-01-RETAILER , and EGG-2026-06-01-WHOLESALER , covering dealers, retailers, and wholesalers in one run.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step5: Dealer broadcast — daily price update + order CTA The EGG-2026-06-01-DEALER template lands on dealer WhatsApp at 7:31 AM with layer egg, jumbo egg, and country egg rates. Place Order opens the ZoAi order capture flow; Talk To Sales hands off to the mapped sales representative.
descriptions.journey_daily_rate_broadcast_step6: Broadcast → order capture → dispatch process The dealer starts from the broadcast CTA and ZoAi captures product, tray quantity, location, and delivery date before creating the order and notifying the Sakku sales representative. Final flow: Broadcast → Order Intent → Quantity Capture → Delivery Capture → Order Creation → Dispatch Process .
